query: CALL { MATCH (n) WITH n ORDER BY coalesce(n.uid,elementId(n)) RETURN collect({key:coalesce(n.uid,'eid:'+elementId(n)),labels:labels(n),properties:properties(n),types:[k IN keys(n)|{key:k,type:valueType(n[k])}]}) AS nodes } CALL { MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WITH a,r,b ORDER BY coalesce(r.uid,elementId(r)) RETURN collect({key:coalesce(r.uid,'eid:'+elementId(r)),source:coalesce(a.uid,'eid:'+elementId(a)),target:coalesce(b.uid,'eid:'+elementId(b)),type:type(r),properties:properties(r),types:[k IN keys(r)|{key:k,type:valueType(r[k])}]}) AS relationships } RETURN nodes,relationships
